title: Settings
subtitle: Only for your account · changes are saved automatically

appearance.theme_hint: Application color scheme. The default for new users is Light.
appearance.language_hint: Menus, buttons and messages are shown in this language.

dashboard.widgets_hint: Choose which blocks appear on the home page. The thumbnail shows how a block looks there. A hidden block's space is filled automatically.
dashboard.footer: Blocks appear on the home page in this order.
dashboard.w_stats_hint: Total revenue, net profit, average order · Success rate · Order statuses · Delivery quality
dashboard.w_financial_hint: Revenue chart (vs previous period) · Cashbox balance
dashboard.w_performance_hint: Courier ranking and «Show more» — the list of all markets and couriers
dashboard.w_region_hint: Province map and table · click a province for its districts

interface.sidebar_hint: How the side menu looks when the app opens. You can collapse or expand it at any time.
interface.footer: Applies on a computer screen. On a phone the menu is in the bottom bar.

scanner.success_sound_hint: Played when a QR code is read successfully — the same for the camera and a USB scanner.
scanner.error_sound_hint: Played when a QR code is not found or scanning fails.
scanner.usb_hint: No setup needed: while the app is open it always listens and accepts every code with Enter. Works together with the camera; the sound choice applies to it too.
scanner.footer: The listen button only plays the sound — the choice does not change.

camera.title: Camera
camera.hint: A phone or tablet camera works as a QR scanner — no USB scanner needed. Settings are saved to your account.
camera.facing_hint: This camera turns on when the scanner opens. Inside the camera you can switch it temporarily with «Switch camera».
camera.facing_user_hint: Laptop, tablet or a phone on a stand
camera.torch_hint: On a device with a flashlight, the camera offers to turn it on in low light. The «Flashlight» button works at any time.
camera.continuous_hint: The camera stays open after a scan and reads the next parcel right away. If turned off, it closes after one code.
camera.sound_hint: A tone plays on every scan. The tone is chosen below.
camera.vibration_hint: Found — one short buzz, error — three. Phone only.
camera.frame_hint: The camera reads only the QR code inside the frame.

notifications.device_hint: When a new order or an important event happens, this device gets a notification — even when the app is closed.
notifications.footer: All notifications are also kept in the notifications inbox.
notifications.scope_title: For now these settings are only saved
notifications.scope_body: Your channel, category and quiet-hours choices are saved but not yet applied when notifications are sent — you will keep receiving everything as before. Once the server side is ready, your saved choices will apply automatically. The “Notifications on this device” switch above already works.
notifications.channel_in_app_hint: Notifications page and the bell icon
notifications.channel_realtime_hint: Show instantly while the app is open
notifications.critical_hint: Critical notifications can't be turned off — they are always delivered
notifications.marketing_hint: News, promotions and advertising messages. You can opt out at any time.
notifications.marketing_toggle_hint: Service notifications (orders, finance, etc.) still arrive even if this is off
notifications.quiet_hint: Don't disturb during the selected time range
